entities.summary: Eduardo Dualde Santos de Lamadrid was a Spanish field hockey player who competed in the 1960 Summer Olympics and in the 1964 Summer Olympics. His elder brother Joaquín Dualde and cousin Ignacio Macaya were also international hockey players.
